name: Serenity
storyline:
Discover a world beyond your imagination, all energy has to go somewhere... right?
Explore the afterworld and seek for the truth, do not be deceived by the Crystaline. They mirror the world into something... beyond your imagination. And it's very, very infectious!
summary: Time is your most valuable resource. In this reflect combat, bullet hell JRPG, your only way to fight back is without any weapons, but only your pulsating charm.
